excludeRects.name: placeholder glyphs (Segoe UI vs SF, sr1-decisions #2)

textOriginGate.yToleranceReason: as textfield/placeholder-v1 (decision 14): Windows draws the body font at 13 DIP Segoe UI Variable Text (G70) and the Mac at 13 pt, measured per run
textOriginGate.scanInteriorReason: no bezel: the text starts 1 px inside the frame edge (x 27 of a frame at 25 on Mac), inside the 2 px side margin of bezeled fields, so the scan starts at the frame edge
